posts.text: Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, promoter can issue preferred at mad (90-trading-day VWAP/ 10-trading-day VWAP) before the “relevant date.” So the promoter took advantage of the beaten down stock.

posts.author: Prabhat_Mohanty
posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: As we know, the company is sitting on a cash pile. On sum of the total business it is cheap. The stock was bitten down due to non distribution of Duestar proceeds. It is still under the Hangover due to action by promoter, who is slowly Ring fencing by cryptic aquisition of shares. Meanwhile financial closure of the copper projects hang in balance. So at present not much to write about except H acid and pigment price increase. Copper ore mine ownership, if it happens will be a positive but it is a long time frame.
